floor_mentions.reason: Formula formation is understood inside the propositional language floor.

not_dependencies.reason: Formula depth is a syntactic measure and does not depend on semantic interpretation.
The statement only concerns formula shape, not truth under a valuation.

statement_assertions: The depth of a formula is recursively defined.
Negations increase the depth of their subformula by 1.
Binary connective formulas have depth equal to the maximum subformula depth plus 1.
statement_conditions: If phi has the form neg psi.
If phi has the form psi circ chi.

statement_dependency_concepts.reason: Depth is defined on formulas and follows their formation structure.
The base case explicitly uses atomic formulas.
The recursive cases distinguish negation and binary connective formation.
The binary connective case uses max of two subformula depths.
The definition is explicitly recursive over formula formation cases.
